payload.reason: The evidence provides specific measures taken to ensure that paths were not shared between the training and test sets, including filtering validation and test sets to exclude hyponym queries seen in the training data.

claims.text: The validation and test sets were filtered to only include hyponym queries that are unseen in the full taxonomy paths of the training data.
None of the queries (synsets) are shared between the training and evaluation sets, although there is some lemma-level overlap.
